title: Thandavam
desc: Swaminathan and Kasinathan are brothers who take good care of their village. Things go awry when Swami suspiciously dies, leaving Kasi to take the helm, and find the truth behind his brother's death.

title: Sigaram Thodu
desc: The son of a brave yet impaired policeman, Murali, dreams of a secure future in banking. However, unforeseen circumstances lead him to follow his father's footsteps in law enforcement.

title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: Ungalukkaga Oruvan
desc: A wealthy entrepreneur returns home to reconcile with a former classmate. Upon discovering his companion's dire predicament, he intervenes and becomes a heroic saviour for the entire community.

title: Idharkuthane Aasaipattai Balakumara
desc: An idle youngster causes chaos in the life of a disciplined banker, whose struggles with his demanding boss are further complicated by the youth's carefree attitude.

title: 3BHK
desc: A middle-class family faces various challenges and setbacks as they strive to achieve their dream of owning a home in the city.

title: Velai Illa Raja
desc: A young man decides to protect his uncle from his nefarious enemy and put an end to his tyranny.

title: Kullanari Koottam
desc: Vetri, an unemployed young man, meets Priya and falls in love with her, but faces challenges when her father wants him to join the police force.

title: Katrathu Kalavu
desc: A boy and a girl, who want to earn quick money, meet and decide to con people for a living. Things change when a politician that they are blackmailing decides to settle scores.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Ism
desc: While doing his mission to eradicate corruption, an undercover journalist experiences a forbidden relationship when he falls in love with a high-profile gangster's daughter.

title: Mynaa
desc: To avoid getting into an unwanted marriage, Mynaa escapes with her childhood love, Suruli, and plans to marry him. Along the way, they face many problems and fate has something drastic in store.

title: Malikappuram
desc: A young aspiring film director who seeks to make his directorial debut decides to use a real-life gangster as inspiration for his first movie.

title: Aruvam
desc: A woman with anosmia experiences paranormal events and soon finds herself involved in a series of mysterious murders linked to food adulteration.

title: Manithan
desc: In order to earn quick money and fame, a struggling lawyer accepts a bribe and joins hands with a man who pretends to be a witness in a case. However, his conscience forces him to fight for justice.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Milaka
desc: Azhagar, a young businessman, falls in love with Madurai. However, her three brothers constantly keep a watch on her activities.
